thread:
maria: heads-up — planning a tenant-shard schema patch + backfill tonight in the 02:00-03:30 UTC change window. will need a short drain and preemptive lock-unblock to avoid long waits. flagging @deploy-bot and @db-oncall

jake: +1. proposed sequence: 1) announce quiesce 2) route writes off shard -> read-only for 90s 3) apply DDL on replica 4) promote + wait for replication 5) run backfill with rate cap 6) unquiesce. set feature flag `tenant_schema_v2` to staged.

sophia: add rollback step: if lock-time > 2m or backfill error rate > 0.5% then abort and revert service pin. escape hatch: `pg_terminate_backend(pid)` on specific locker session only after 2 approvals. mention ops in thread. :warning:

maria: noted. i'll post the rollout instructions in #oncall-runbook and add the manual holdpoint after step 3. also leaving a small safety window for monitoring metrics (QPS, p50/p99, db lock wait).

deploy-bot: deploybot: preflight checks starting for run 3818009999 — verifying replica lags, migration SQL checksum, and backfill worker availability.

alejandro: quick sanity: please pin the api service to `v2026.03.18-runtime` during the rollout. we've seen unexpected schema mismatch errors when code drifted.

jake: will lock the pin before quiesce. also adding a small migration-only route that returns 409 for new schema writes until flag flips.

maria: copy. schedule: 02:05 UTC quiesce, 02:08 apply DDL on replica, 02:12 promote, 02:20 start backfill (rate 1000 rows/min), 03:00 verify counts, 03:10 unquiesce.

sophia: backfill command (ops run):
```
python tools/backfill.py --shard tenant-17 --batch-size 500 --sleep-ms 50 --dry-run=false
```
Keep monitoring `pg_stat_activity` and the `locks` metric in console.

db-oncall: watching locks and replication. i'll escalate to infra if active locks exceed 3 for >30s. i'll also run a quick vacuum after DDL if needed.

maria: thanks — i'll update the release notes with the rollback triggers and the pinned runtime. i'll also attach the small coverage prompt for post-backfill validation. :white_check_mark:

jake: ok from me. if deploy-bot reports any preflight failures, abort and notify #eng-oncall. otherwise i'll start the quiesce 5m before window.

deploy-bot: deploybot: preflight completed — replica lag OK, checksums match, workers healthy. ready for manual kickoff.

maria: launching quiesce at T-5. moving to #oncall-runbook for holdpoint ops.
